craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of demolition and retorsion — utsāha as each counterfeit falls and the proof-text turns witness. Iron-bars counterexample kept (the absurd test is the proof); both lines nominal; one-selfhood end-weight. Rejected: (a) cutting iron bars → killed: the counterexample IS the verse. (b) asaṃbandhāt rival parse → killed: sense identical per BOUNDARY. Read aloud: NOT-un-BROK-en NEAR-ness … SO-fu-sion OF the MAN-y's-FORM: THAT a-LONE, ONE-self-HOOD.

lines: Not unbroken nearness — it misses relation: were it so,
So fusion of the many's form: that alone, one-selfhood.
notes: both lines nominal, mirroring verbless SA

reads_against.argmap: Is uninterruptedness the relation — and what positively is it? → Third reduction fails (with the iron-bars counterexample); positive thesis: relation is the many's form-fused one-selfhood.
c1_essence: Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5).
The Buddhist proof-text is turned against its makers: unmixed things thought-joined is no mere thought but unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable in recognition's path (vv6-9).
